general_proof_obligations.obligation: For every n>=1 in R[x], the leading coefficient n*a_n is nonzero; therefore only constants lie in the kernel.
Subtracting the exact leading-term primitive reduces degree; induction with constant base establishes surjectivity for all finite degrees.
An invertible variable map bijects positive/negative subspaces preserving their dimensions; invertible left/right factors preserve rank.
Distinct roots make the multiplicity factors coprime; degree bound forces a constant quotient uniquely fixed by f(0)=1.
Finite double sums prove tr(ST)=tr(TS) in every dimension n>=1; the real scalar n cannot vanish.
Derivative and multiplication are endomorphisms of infinite-dimensional R[x]; product rule gives the identity without a finite trace.
